India Struggles to Utilize Growing Green Energy Production

India is experiencing a significant increase in solar and wind power generation, but is facing challenges in effectively utilizing this green energy due to transmission shortages. Despite rapid decarbonization of its electricity sector, the country is reportedly wasting a substantial amount of its renewable energy output.
